policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 11. Record ten confirmed modern-physics science targets as verify-only science_retained checkpoints. No Person domain write is requested; all ten must remain live Production knowledge until final cutover.

review_scope.selection_rule: Choose a coherent modern-physics and astrophysics cohort with clear representative scientific identity and verified latest numbered-batch provenance. Exclude genuine philosophy/science boundary cases and Persons whose latest provenance is not yet established.

science_retained.basis: Chandrasekhar's representative identity is theoretical astrophysics, especially stellar structure and evolution. This is directly within the v2 science scope.
Bohr is represented by foundational theoretical physics on atomic structure and quantum theory. His representative identity is unambiguously scientific.
Schrödinger's representative identity is theoretical physics and the wave-mechanical formulation of quantum mechanics. His philosophical interests are secondary to that scientific identity.
Curie's representative identity is experimental physics and chemistry, especially research on radioactivity and the discovery and study of radium and polonium. The v2 target is science.
Fermi is represented by theoretical and experimental nuclear physics, including neutron-induced reactions and foundational work in modern physics. The v2 target is science.
Dirac's representative identity is theoretical physics, particularly relativistic quantum theory and atomic theory. This falls directly within v2 science.
Heisenberg's representative identity is theoretical physics and the creation of quantum mechanics, including the uncertainty relation. The v2 target is science.
Salam's representative identity is theoretical particle physics, especially electroweak unification. The v2 target is science.
Röntgen's representative identity is experimental physics, defined by the discovery and investigation of X-rays. The v2 target is science.
Bose's representative identity is theoretical physics and quantum statistics, especially the work that led to Bose-Einstein statistics. The v2 target is science.
